units.unreal_basis: location_cm = [Blender_x * 100, -Blender_y * 100, Blender_z * 100]; Force Front XAxis must be false

building.collision_policy: All source occupied boxes from the v4 manifest are preserved individually as UCX meshes, with no truncation or subdivision
building.pivot_mode: geometry_bounds_center; original world geometry is unchanged

material_notes: Original material names are preserved. FBX carries base textures and material slots; reconstruct glass transmission/IOR and roughness in Unreal materials.
Fresh broken concrete in the GLB has constant base color. The browser-only procedural grain shader must be recreated in Unreal.
Rubble uses flat chipped concrete facets, sparse aggregate colors, and swept circular rebar with raised ribs. Its origins are centred at (0,0,0) for individual mesh import.
